spec.name: Tulip Mill
spec.description: A stylized Dutch windmill in Animal Crossing proportions: a cream plaster tower on a stone plinth, a balcony gallery, a slate-blue onion cap with a tail-pole winch, four lattice sails, and tulips by the door.
spec.layout: The mill faces +Z. From the ground up: a chunky stone plinth (y 0-0.65) with a tapered cream plaster shaft above it (radius 1.05 at the base narrowing to 0.72 at y 3.35, axis through z=0); the arched front door and round-topped windows sit on the front face, with a cobble apron and tulips at the foot. A timber gallery ring wraps the tower at y 2.45 with a white-balustrade railing. On top sits a stepped slate-blue onion dome cap (y 3.35-4.55) with a gold finial and a small weather vane; the sail axle exits the front of the cap at the hub [0, 3.95, 1.05], and four lattice sails (blades 1.9 long) face the viewer, one pair vertical and one pair horizontal in rest pose, so the sail tips reach y 5.9 and set the silhouette's top. A stout timber tail pole runs from the cap's rear down to the ground behind the mill, ending in a windlass drum on a small A-frame - it reaches y=0, so the cap part also touches the floor. The style shows everywhere as chunky rounded shapes, a warm cream-and-terracotta body against the cool slate cap, white window frames, gold fittings, and little flat-colour flowers and trim seated on the surfaces.

parts.builds: Stone plinth plus the tapered plaster tower and its entrance, resting on y=0. Plinth: two courses of chunky rounded stone blocks (stone, with stoneDark inset rings as mortar gaps between blocks) from y=0 to 0.65, half-width about 1.3, corners rounded, with a chamfered top edge. Shaft: a smooth lathe/loft body from y=0.65 (radius 1.05) to y=3.35 (radius 0.72) on the axis x=0, z=0, in plaster, with a plasterShade band over the lowest 0.5 m of the shaft, a brick base course ring at y 0.65-0.78, and brick quoin stones (brick, alternating with brickDark) stepping up both front corners. Entrance on the front (+Z), centred on the doorFront mount: an arched door y 0.12-1.5, width 0.62, panelled in door with timberDark frame, a ring of brick voussoirs around the arch, a small gold ring handle, and a white doorstep slab. Windows: a round-topped window at y 2.0 and a smaller one at y 2.95, both white-framed with glass panes and timberDark sills; one small square white-framed window on each flank at y 1.6. Top: a flared plaster eaves ring from y 3.2 to 3.35 flaring out to radius 0.8, plasterShade on its underside, finishing flat on the towerTop mount at y 3.35.
parts.attaches: Plinth sits on the floor. Top rim meets the cap part on the towerTop mount; the front face meets the dooryard at the doorFront mount; the galleryRing mount sits inside this part's shaft at y 2.45 where the gallery wraps it.

parts.builds: The ring walkway balcony around the tower at y 2.45, wrapping the shaft at the galleryRing mount. Deck: an annular timber deck (top y 2.5, thickness 0.08) from inner radius 0.82 to outer radius 1.45, built as timber planks with thin timberDark gaps, supported by 8 carved timberDark brackets hugging the tower at even angles. Railing on the outer edge: 12 chunky timber posts (about 0.5 tall with rounded caps), a rounded timber top rail at y 2.98 and a mid rail at y 2.78, with small white balusters between them; every third post gets a small gold ball finial on its cap. On the front of the gallery, centred above the door, hang a white window-box with flowerPink blooms and leafGreen leaves spilling over its rim. Everything sits above the floor, inside the box.
parts.attaches: Inner edge hugs the tower shaft around the galleryRing mount; the deck does not touch the cap or the sails.

parts.builds: The onion dome cap, its finial and weather vane, and the tail pole with winch. Dome: a lathe onion dome seated on the towerTop mount at y 3.35, base radius 0.85, drawn as 4 stepped shingle tiers rising to y 4.35, alternating roof and roofDark bands, each tier's lower edge scalloped with small ridge bumps; a white trim band runs around the very bottom of the cap and a small round attic window (glass in a white frame) sits on the dome front at y 4.0. Finial: a gold ball (r 0.09) at y 4.5 on a short roof-coloured neck, topped by a simple weather vane at y 4.6-4.8 (a white arrow and tail on a gold rod). Axle exit: a white collar ring where the sail axle passes through the dome front toward the sailHub mount, and the hub-side bearing plate there. Tail pole (staart): a stout timber pole from the cap's rear at about [0, 3.6, -0.55] down to [0, 0.12, -2.0], with 4 short timberDark rungs, a small white rope coil (rope) around the drum, and a windlass drum (timberDark, radius 0.14) with two crank handles; the pole's lower end rests in a small A-frame of two timber posts with stone feet planted on y=0, so this part touches the floor.
parts.attaches: Dome base seats over the tower top ring on the towerTop mount; the axle collar opens onto the sailHub mount in front; the tail pole and A-frame stand on the ground behind the tower without touching it.

parts.builds: The four lattice sails on the sailHub mount at [0, 3.95, 1.05], facing +Z. Hub: a timberDark drum cylinder (r 0.17, depth 0.34 along z) with gold band rings on both faces and a small gold domed cap on the front. Four blades at 90-degree steps around the z axis, in rest pose one pair vertical (up and down) and one pair horizontal (left and right): each blade is a main spar (rounded timber box, 1.9 long, 0.16 wide, 0.07 thick) running from r 0.15 to r 1.9 from the hub with a rounded tip cap, carrying 7 evenly spaced cross-slats (timber), and 3 sail cloth panels (cloth, 0.05 thick, mounted slightly forward of the spar plane at z +0.04) filling the lattice with one gap left empty so the lattice reads; small white tie knots (white) at each panel corner. All blades share one construction, rotated around the hub. Lowest sail tip is at y 2.05, so nothing hangs below the floor and the sails are clearly above the gallery.
parts.attaches: Hub rides the sailHub joint exactly at the sailHub mount, in front of the cap's axle collar.

parts.builds: The doorstep scene in front of the door. Apron: a flat cobble doorstep from z 1.05 to 1.75 at the doorFront mount, width 1.6, made of flattened rounded cobble stones (alternating stone and stoneDark, top at y 0.1). Lantern post: a timber post 0.9 tall at [0.75, 0, 1.55] with a white-framed lantern box (glass panes) holding a warm glowing core (glow) under a small gold cap. Tulips: 3 tulips (tulipStem stems, leafGreen leaves, cups of tulipRed and tulipOrange) on the left of the apron and 2 on the right, plus a small leafGreen bush tucked at the plinth's front corner. All grounded on y=0.
parts.attaches: Apron sits on the floor against the tower's front face at the doorFront mount; nothing else in this part.
